recipe.title: Assign vans to overlapping pickups and deliveries
recipe.scenario: Assign one available van to each independent pickup or delivery. All three job windows overlap, so each van can take at most one job. A van must cover the full window and carry the job's weight. This example does not link pickups to deliveries, enforce pickup-before-delivery route ordering, combine loads for aggregate capacity, or plan multi-stop routes.

field.name: job-names
field.description: Jobs in input order: Parcel pickup, Depot delivery, Small-box drop.

field.name: job-weights-kg
field.description: Whole kilograms per job, in job order: 450,700,150.

field.name: job-windows-minutes
field.description: Start and end pairs in minutes after midnight on one day: 540,570; 550,590; 555,600. All three intervals overlap.

field.name: vehicle-names
field.description: Vans in zero-based index order: Large van, Short-shift van, Late-start van.

field.name: vehicle-capacities-kg
field.description: Per-vehicle usable load limits in whole kilograms: 1000,500,800.

field.name: vehicle-windows-minutes
field.description: Availability start and end pairs in minutes after midnight: 510,620; 530,580; 545,630.

field.name: eligible-pairs
field.description: Precomputed job and vehicle index pairs from full window containment and per-job capacity: 0,0; 0,1; 1,0; 1,2; 2,0; 2,2. The solver receives these as assignment domains and does not recompute them from weights or windows.

field.name: preferred-depot-vehicle
field.description: Optional vehicle index preferred for Depot delivery. The example prefers Late-start van, index 2. A preference never overrides eligibility or overlap.

field.name: assigned-vehicles
field.description: For a feasible result, one vehicle index per job in input order. The example yields 1,2,0.
